description: CockroachDB 26.x node start flags and cluster settings.

fields.name: store_path
fields.description: --store path= : the data directory, on the mounted data disk.
fields.title: Store path

fields.name: store_size
fields.description: --store size= : maximum store size as a percentage (25%) or a size (100GiB). Upstream default is 100%.
fields.title: Store size

fields.name: ballast_size
fields.description: --store ballast-size= : a reserved file that can be deleted to recover a full disk; 0 disables it.
fields.title: Ballast size

fields.name: cache
fields.description: --cache : block cache, a percentage or a size. The upstream default (128MiB up to 24.x, 256MiB from 25.4) is far too small for a benchmark node.
fields.title: Cache

fields.name: max_sql_memory
fields.description: --max-sql-memory : budget for SQL execution (sorts, joins, results).
fields.title: Max SQL memory

fields.name: max_tsdb_memory
fields.description: --max-tsdb-memory : budget for the built-in time-series store that feeds the DB Console.
fields.title: Max TSDB memory

fields.name: locality
fields.description: --locality : ordered "key=value,key=value" pairs describing where the node runs. Filled by the server from topology (region/zone of the machine).
fields.title: Locality

fields.name: join
fields.description: --join : the addresses of the other nodes. Filled by the server from topology; identical on every node.
fields.title: Join addresses

fields.name: advertise_addr
fields.description: --advertise-addr : how other nodes and clients reach this one. Filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: Advertise address

fields.name: listen_addr
fields.description: --listen-addr : interface and port for inter-node and SQL traffic.
fields.title: Listen address

fields.name: http_addr
fields.description: --http-addr : DB Console and /_status/vars (the Prometheus endpoint the run scrapes).
fields.title: HTTP address

fields.name: sql_addr
fields.description: --sql-addr : a separate listener for client SQL; empty shares --listen-addr.
fields.title: SQL address

fields.name: insecure
fields.description: --insecure : no TLS, no authentication. Acceptable only inside the run's private network, which is where these stands live.
fields.title: Insecure

fields.name: certs_dir
fields.description: --certs-dir : node and CA certificates; read only in secure mode.
fields.title: Certificates directory

fields.name: max_offset
fields.description: --max-offset : tolerated clock skew between nodes; a node that exceeds it kills itself. Must be identical on all nodes (upstream default 500ms).
fields.title: Max clock offset

fields.name: cluster_name
fields.description: --cluster-name : guards against a node joining the wrong cluster; must match on every node.
fields.title: Cluster name

fields.name: log
fields.description: --log : the logging configuration as a YAML string. Empty leaves the built-in default (file logs under the store).
fields.title: Log configuration

fields.name: cluster_settings
fields.description: SET CLUSTER SETTING <name> = <value>, applied once against the first node after the cluster is initialized.

rules.message: cluster setting names look like kv.snapshot_rebalance.max_rate

fields.title: Cluster settings

fields.name: wal_failover
fields.description: --wal-failover : when a store's disk stalls, keep writing its WAL to another store instead of blocking. Needs at least two stores; disabled on a single-store node.
fields.title: WAL failover

fields.name: locality_advertise_addr
fields.description: --locality-advertise-addr : "key=value@address" pairs letting nodes in the same locality use a private address. Filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: Locality advertise address

fields.name: max_disk_temp_storage
fields.description: --max-disk-temp-storage : disk budget queries may spill to. Upstream default 32GiB; it is taken out of the store, so it must fit inside --store size.
fields.title: Max disk temp storage

fields.name: settings_sql
fields.description: Derived: the SET CLUSTER SETTING block.

computed.expr:
("cluster_settings" in root)
					? root.cluster_settings.map(k, "SET CLUSTER SETTING " + k + " = " + string(root.cluster_settings[k]) + ";").join("\n")
					: ""

fields.title: Rendered SQL

fields.name: modern_flags
fields.description: Derived: --wal-failover, --max-disk-temp-storage and --locality-advertise-addr.
fields.title: Rendered 25.x/26.x flags
